anchor.description: for `event_bound`: the register and field whose value starts the clock, and a one-line description of the event

applies_to_form.description: the contract form the standard is written for; `statute` for a legislative rule, `any` when form-independent

caveat.description: what bounds the standard: an amendment that may change it, a paywalled text read second-hand, a regional exception

consequence.description: what missing the standard costs, as the source states it

dispute_type.description: which of the five dispute types the standard defends

grade.description: how close to the source the reading was

jurisdiction.description: where the standard applies: `AU` or `NZ` for a national form or Act, `AU-QLD` etc. for a state Act; drives the platform partition

kind.description: how the standard is measured: a cadence (`periodic`), a window after an anchor event (`event_bound`), a retention period (`retention`) or a standing condition (`state`)

minimum_content.description: the fields the evidence record must carry to count, as the source lists them

register.description: the tenant register the evidence lands in, as a shelf_type

register_match.description: equality predicate on that register selecting the evidence, e.g. `{"notice_kind": "latent_condition"}`

research_row.description: the row id in the research record this standard was transcribed from (e.g. `L2`, `NP5`)

source_title.description: the contract form, Act, specification or guidance the standard comes from

source_url.description: a resolvable link to the source text, or to the reliable secondary that quotes it

source_version.description: the edition or legislation version date read

standard_key.description: stable id of the standard, e.g. `payment.schedule_due.au-qld`; the supersede key with `source_version`

window_source_field.description: the `contract_terms` field whose value overrides `window_value` when the contract states its own window

window_unit.description: unit of `window_value`; business and working days follow the governing statute or contract definition

window_value.description: the cadence or window length in `window_unit`; null when the source says only 'promptly' or 'as soon as practicable'
